extDescription.message: Highlights war sponsor brands on Rozetka, Silpo, and Instagram to help you shop consciously.

badgeAriaLabel.message: Warning: this brand's parent company is linked to funding the war

badgeAriaLabelLeft.message: This brand's parent company has exited the Russian market

unknownCorpInfo.message: This company is not yet documented in the database. Please check independent sources before drawing conclusions.

optionsSubtitle.message: All matching happens locally on your device. Nothing you browse is ever sent anywhere.

previewHint.message: Updates instantly as you change settings on this page.

domainListHint.message: Choose whether the list below is sites to skip, or the only sites to run on.

catalogIntro.message: Every brand in the database, searchable and filterable. Each entry links to its source — nothing here is asserted without one.

transparencyIntro.message: Every claim this extension makes traces back to a public, independently-checkable source. Nothing is asserted without a citation.

transparencyPipelineStep1.message: Company status, and reported Russia revenue/tax figures, come from the KSE Institute's Leave-Russia database.

transparencyPipelineStep2.message: Sub-brand → parent-company relationships come from Wikidata's structured "owned by" data, cross-checked against Open Food Facts where possible.

transparencyPipelineStep3.message: Every entry in the database links back to its specific source page, not just this extension's word for it.

transparencyKseDesc.message: Kyiv School of Economics Institute's tracker of company operations in Russia since 2022 — the primary source for corporation status and financial figures.

transparencyNacpDesc.message: Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention's own list of international war sponsors was taken offline in March 2024; propaganda flags here use a dated snapshot via Wikipedia's citation of that list, clearly labeled wherever shown.

transparencyWikidataDesc.message: Collaborative structured knowledge base used to resolve which sub-brands belong to which parent corporation.

transparencyExportDesc.message: Download the full dataset to inspect, audit, or reuse elsewhere.

howItWorksIntro.message: What the badge you see on a product actually means.

howItWorksStep1Desc.message: The page is scanned for product/brand names using structured data the site already publishes (JSON-LD, microdata) or, as a fallback, the page title.

howItWorksStep2Desc.message: The detected brand is matched against a local database mapping brands to their parent corporation.

howItWorksStep3Desc.message: If the parent corporation is sourced as continuing operations in Russia, a badge is shown with its status and a link to the source.

howItWorksStep4Desc.message: The extension flags — it doesn't decide for you. Click through to the source and judge for yourself.

legendHigh.message: High — still operating, substantial reported Russia revenue/taxes

legendMedium.message: Medium — still operating, moderate reported figures

legendLow.message: Low — still operating, minimal reported figures

legendLeft.message: Left Russia — company has exited the market

legendUnknown.message: Unknown — not yet verified against a source

privacyNote.message: Stop Sponsor does not collect, transmit, or store any of your browsing activity. Brand matching runs entirely in your browser; the only network request is fetching the public brand database itself.
